TRACKING UNCHANGED: open pixel, `/api/track/email/<id>/click/<n>` rewrite, secret-link exemption, `List-Unsubscribe` + one-click post all still live in `lib/mailer.ts` and every template's own unsubscribe link is kept. Guard: `test/email-templates-overhaul.test.ts` renders every template (`lib/email-samples.ts`, fails if a catalog key lacks a sample) and asserts the pre-overhaul link inventory (`test/fixtures/email-tracking-inventory.json`, captured from main) is preserved, pixel/click rewrite works and secret links stay direct. Preview all: `scripts/email-preview.ts`; inventory dump: `scripts/email-inventory.ts`.
7109:- **2026-10-14 — Admin file manager, storage analytics and "Running apps" (branch `feature/nx-admin-filemanager`, NOT merged, NOT deployed; schema push needed; node-agent v6 rollout is an owner step; everything fail-closed until then).** `/admin/files`: master file manager over every node (primary through a new loopback `nxeon-fs-agent`, the rest through node-agent v6): browse, view/edit text (atomic save, stale-write refusal), streamed download, chunked streamed upload (8 MiB chunks under nginx's 20 MB limit), new file/folder, rename/move, delete = move to a 7-day trash (restore/purge, hourly expiry), hard delete only with the typed name. Path jail on both sides (app: lexical, per-node roots in `FileManagerNodeConfig`; agent: realpath, symlinks never escape, mount points and nested filesystems refused, DB data dirs detected by marker files), protected paths (secrets never readable; Proxmox config/VM images, DB dirs, system dirs, `.ssh`, `.env`, roots never writable), size caps, per-admin rate limits, global read-only mode ON by default + per-node read-only + agent-side write switch. ADMIN only, refused while impersonating, every call (including refusals) audit-logged as `admin.fm.*` with actor/node/path. `/admin/storage`: hourly per-node report (filesystems, ZFS pools with NVMe/SSD/HDD media from lsblk, disks, zvols, backup dirs) into `StorageSample` history (growth chart, per-pool sparkline, growth/day), daily deep scan (du depth-limited + largest files, nice 19 + ionice idle, only 7-8 UTC or "Scan now", refused by the node when busy) into `StorageNodeState`/`StorageDirSample`, customer-VM vs template vs other-VM vs Nxeon-app vs backup split, STORAGE alerts at 80%/90% through the fleet-alert machinery. `/admin/storage/running`: read-only node processes/docker/guests (agent) and per-customer-server "Inspect" over SSH (fixed read-only command, stored in `ServerInventorySnapshot`, audited). Additive tables: `FileManagerNodeConfig`, `StorageSample`, `StorageNodeState`, `StorageDirSample`, `ServerInventorySnapshot`. See "Admin file manager and storage analytics".
# Cyrus documentation (internal, staff-facing)

Cyrus is Nxeon's AI game-mod studio: a typed mod engine, studios and designers, a CC0 asset library, a bridge to Nxeon accounts, money and game servers, and its own portals and site (cyrus.my). This folder is the complete, **living** record of the project: what exists, how it works, what was decided, what is verified and what is not.

> Last status sweep: 2026-10-11. Honesty rules: **built** = merged into the integration branch `feature/cyrus-r2` and verified on node-2, **NOT deployed**; **pending** = on an unmerged branch; **parked** = owner hold. Pages 00-14 are written by hand; `reference/` is GENERATED from the code by `scripts/cyrus/docs-build.ts` and checked by `test/cyrus-docs-coverage.test.ts`. No secrets and no descriptions of the owner's game-asset archives belong here.

## Start here
- New to Cyrus: [00 overview](00-overview.md), then [01 architecture](01-architecture.md).
- "Where are we?": [12 gaps and roadmap](12-gaps-and-roadmap.md), [11 history](11-history.md).
- Working on it: [14 how to work here](14-how-to-work-here.md) (rules, resume, docs checklist).
- Deploying: [07 operations](07-operations.md), the owner runbook [CYRUS-DEPLOY-RUNBOOK.md](../CYRUS-DEPLOY-RUNBOOK.md) and the owner-only test deploy of release candidate rc1 [CYRUS-TEST-DEPLOY.md](../CYRUS-TEST-DEPLOY.md).

## Support and product copy (r50)
Staff-facing content for running Cyrus day to day: [support macros](support/macros.md), [customer-app copy review](support/copy-review.md), [email templates](support/email-templates.md), [status page copy](support/status-page.md), [launch announcement draft](support/whats-new.md). The customer help articles themselves live in `content/cyrus/help` and are described in [06 portals](06-portals.md#help-center-plans-page-and-product-copy-r50).

## The pages
| Page | What it covers |
|---|---|
| [00 overview](00-overview.md) | what Cyrus is, product, plans Katara/Saka/Yakko, vision |
| [01 architecture](01-architecture.md) | layers, host seam, the Nxeon <-> Cyrus bridge both ways, monorepo/deploy plan, data-flow diagrams |
| [02 engine](02-engine.md) | ModSpec and revisions, router and adapters, version registry, build pipeline and service, Test Flight, delivery and rollback, managed plugins and pack hosting, conflict engine and Mod Packs, import, data packs and worldgen, creatures, designers, item states, config, motion, meshgen, playtest/Doctor/telemetry, Try It, multi-version, legacy 1.21.1, capabilities, eval |
| [03 studios](03-studios.md) | Texture, Sound, Model (viewport, editor, layer 3), Motion, Config, designer UIs, Forge/modules (pending) |
| [04 assets and library](04-assets-and-library.md) | legal ledger and classes, licence rules, catalog v2, ingestion and staging, owner SFX status, game-derived reference policy, motion asset program, library backend, takedown/filters |
| [05 bridge and accounts](05-bridge-and-accounts.md) | SSO, identity, wallet/tokens, plans, entitlement sync, Platform API and grants, API v1, webhooks, domain mode |

| [09 testing and verification](09-testing-and-verification.md) | suites and ratchets, flights index, eval harness, test-day kit, verified vs not |
| [10 decisions](10-decisions.md) | ADR-style log of every owner decision, parked items |
